name: bpe-tokenizer-from-scratch
title: Build a BPE Tokenizer from Scratch

parts.title: Corpus & Symbols
parts.description: Pre-tokenize text into words and represent each as a sequence of symbols with an end-of-word marker.

parts.title: Pair Statistics & Merging
parts.description: Count adjacent symbol-pair frequencies, find the most frequent pair, and merge it across the corpus.

parts.title: Training the Merges
parts.description: Learn an ordered list of merges and build the rank table that drives encoding.

parts.title: Tokenizing & Vocab
parts.description: Greedily apply learned merges to a word and assign integer ids to every token.

parts.title: Encode & Decode
parts.description: Turn text into token ids and reconstruct the original text from ids.

steps.name: pretokenize
steps.doc: Split text on whitespace into a list of non-empty word strings.

steps.name: word_to_symbols
steps.doc: Return the word's characters followed by the END marker as a tuple.

steps.name: build_word_frequencies
steps.doc: Map each word's symbol-tuple to the number of times that word occurs.

steps.name: initial_vocab
steps.doc: Return the set of all distinct symbols appearing across the keys.

steps.name: count_pairs
steps.doc: Count every adjacent symbol pair, weighted by each word's frequency.

steps.name: best_pair
steps.doc: Return the highest-count pair, breaking ties by lexicographically smallest pair.

steps.name: merge_word
steps.doc: Replace each adjacent occurrence of pair=(a,b) in the tuple with the merged symbol a+b.

steps.name: apply_merge
steps.doc: Return a new word_freqs with pair merged in every key, preserving frequencies.

steps.name: train_bpe
steps.doc: Return the ordered list of merge pairs learned by greedy BPE over the corpus.

steps.name: build_merge_ranks
steps.doc: Map each merge pair to its position (rank) in the learned merge list.

steps.name: bpe_encode_word
steps.doc: Greedily merge the word's symbols by repeatedly applying the lowest-rank adjacent merge until none remain.

steps.name: build_token_to_id
steps.doc: Assign ids to the sorted initial symbols, then to each merged token in merge order, with no duplicates.

steps.name: build_id_to_token
steps.doc: Return the inverse mapping from id back to token string.

steps.name: encode
steps.doc: Tokenize text into BPE tokens and map them to their integer ids.

steps.name: decode
steps.doc: Map ids back to tokens and reconstruct the original whitespace-joined text.
